test_ROIAlignRotated_forward_output: test the ROIAlignRotated forward pass output at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degree rotation angles
test_ROIAlignRotated_resize_invariance: test the ROIAlignRotated resize invariance by comparing outputs on original and halved input images
test_ROIAlignRotated_empty_box: test the ROIAlignRotated layer with an empty box having zero width and height
test_ROIAlignRotated_gradcheck_cpu: test the ROIAlignRotated gradient correctness on CPU using PyTorch gradcheck
test_ROIAlignRotated_gradient_cuda: test the ROIAlignRotated gradients on CUDA and compare them with standard ROIAlign gradients
